status.evidence: According to the UK Companies House registry, PROLIUS LIMITED (Company number 13561339) is currently active and has a registered office address in London.

claims.claim: Prolius Ltd reports in its official product specifications that its platform performs custom API integrations with third-party telematics providers such as Trakm8 and Teletrac Navman to ingest live journey tracking, GPS mapping, and driver incident alerts.

The company reports that its software architecture integrates with third-party telematics platforms, such as an official software integration partnership with Teletrac Navman to ingest live vehicle data, driver behavior metrics, and route optimization metrics into a unified dashboard.

The company reports that its platform integrates with external telematics hardware and platforms, including Trakm8 Insight telematics for diagnostics and integrated telematics cameras, as well as Teletrac Navman.

The company reports that its platform operates to ISO 27001 standards, ensures GDPR compliance for each operator, and utilizes a secure Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud computing environment with SSL technology for file transmission.
claims.note: with SSL technology for file transmission

claims.claim: The company reports that its platform features an open API framework enabling integration with third-party telematics platforms, fuel cards, and enterprise systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and Oracle.
The company reports successful large-scale enterprise deployments servicing over 30,000 vehicles and 100,000 assets for major UK infrastructure clients including Exolum, Skanska, and Yorkshire Water.

The company reports providing its unified fleet, asset, and workforce management services to 30,000+ vehicles and 100,000+ assets, listing prominent UK enterprises and infrastructure entities including Skanska, Yorkshire Water, Gridserve, Exolum, M Group, and ICL as trusted clients.

The company reports executing a digital transformation project for energy infrastructure provider Exolum, deploying its centralised fleet management platform to deliver end-to-end visibility and workshop integration for a business with a turnover of £500m+.
claims.note: The inclusion of 'workshop integration' specifically for the Exolum deployment is unconfirmed; the official case profile lists 'improved data insights' alongside end-to-end visibility.

claims.claim: The company reports serving enterprise clients in the UK including Skanska, Yorkshire Water, Gridserve, Exolum, M Group, and Halfords, scaling its system footprint to over 30,000 vehicles and 100,000 assets.
Integration partnership with Geotab, established to offer Prolius Fleet Management through the Geotab Marketplace for connecting telematics and fleet management capabilities.
Integration partnership with Teletrac Navman, offering unified fleet management software and compliance automation via the Teletrac Navman marketplace.

The company reports that its B2B SaaS platform services over 30,000 vehicles and more than 100,000 assets for enterprise clients, including Skanska, Yorkshire Water, and DB Cargo, according to the Prolius Official Profile (https://www.prolius.com/about).

Prolius Ltd maintains a physical corporate headquarters at the Barley Mow Centre, 10 Barley Mow Passage in London, United Kingdom, where it provides telephone-based customer support strictly from Monday to Friday, between 09:00 and 18:00 GMT.
Prolius Ltd acts as a privately held software development entity with an estimated operational team size of 11 to 50 employees as listed on its official corporate registries.
claims.note: estimated operational team size of 11 to 50 employees

status.evidence: According to UK Companies House records, AC Security Solutions Limited is an active private limited company based in Chessington, incorporated in March 2004.

claims.claim: A technical partnership with Maple Fleet Services incorporates AdvancedFleet Telematics with locking hardware to enable secure remote control of commercial vehicle cargo doors.

The company reports that its AC Cloud platform integrates real-time GPS fleet tracking (with a 0.5-second refresh rate), geofencing, driver behavior monitoring, and vehicle diagnostics via its website.

A completed project announced in 2024 where AC Security Solutions partnered with Maple Fleet Services to deliver a "Complete Remote Protection" solution integrating Maple's FreightLock IQ with the AdvancedFleet Telematics platform for secure remote door locking via their software portal.
claims.note: The year 2024 and 'software portal' are not explicitly stated in published materials for this project.

claims.claim: The company reports supplying an integrated hardware portfolio featuring dual-facing AI dashcams with ADAS and DMS capabilities, 360-degree bird's-eye drone-view systems, cargo monitoring cameras, and the ACTRACK-ASSET-LTE GPS tracker designed for cloud fleet management.

The company reports a hardware integration partnership with Samsara to deliver synchronized 360-degree camera coverage alongside a joint security tracking venture with Maple Fleet Services combining its FreightLock IQ locking system with ACSS's AdvancedFleet telematics.
The company reports obtaining AES256 encryption approval for its systems according to its corporate history.
claims.note: obtaining AES256 encryption approval for its systems according to its corporate history

claims.claim: The company's TaxiView platform offers ICO-compliant remote CCTV access for taxi and private hire vehicle fleets, as stated in its product marketing material.

AC Security Solutions Ltd announced a commercial partnership with Samsara in 2024 to deliver integrated 360-degree camera coverage by combining ACSS hardware systems with Samsara's telematics architecture.
The company is included as an approved CCTV and fleet management supplier for taxis and private hire vehicles by the Wolverhampton local authority.

Financial filings on Companies House show that AC Security Solutions Limited submitted total exemption full accounts for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2025, qualifying under small company thresholds.

AC Security Solutions Ltd is an official UK-based partner of Samsara, allowing the integration of existing cameras into the Samsara dashboard and offering local deployment and consultation for Samsara’s connected operations cloud.
claims.source: ACSS official website - Samsara Partners page (https://acss-uk.co.uk/partners/samsara/) and Samsara integration overview (https://acss-uk.co.uk/solutions/cameras-integration-with-samsara/)

claims.claim: The company partnered with vehicle safety and security provider Maple Fleet Services to co-develop the "Complete Remote Protection" solution, combining Maple's FreightLock IQ locking system with AdvancedFleet Telematics.
claims.source: ACSS official website - Complete Remote Protection solution overview (https://acss-uk.co.uk/solutions/complete-remote-protection/)

claims.claim: The company reports having helped thousands of clients improve fleet safety and make roads safer over its 20-year history of supplying bespoke mobile CCTV and security systems.
claims.note: The detail 'helped thousands of clients' is not confirmed in the published company text, which only states they have over 20 years of experience supplying bespoke solutions.
claims.source: ACSS official website - About/History and Vehicle CCTV sections (https://acss-uk.co.uk/solutions/vehicle-cctv/ and https://acss-uk.co.uk/who-we-are/)

claims.claim: Public corporate registers profile the company as a micro-entity operating with fewer than 10 employees, while third-party professional networks trace a total estimated workforce of between 11 and 50 personnel.
claims.source: Endole Open Corporate Register (https://open.endole.co.uk/insight/company/05087228-ac-security-solutions-limited) and ACSS Official LinkedIn Profile (https://uk.linkedin.com/company/acss-uk)
